headings.usage: Use for all card titles, stats numbers, and primary labels. Ensure tight tracking (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`) for an athletic, intense feel.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, quotes, and secondary labels. Clean, readable, and human.

rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000) or fully black backgrounds for the cards. Use forest_green_dark (#12402A) or ink (#182016) tinted with green.
Volt lime is for high-emphasis data points, icons, or primary CTAs. Do not overuse.
Cream is for soft, human, breathable backgrounds.
Gold is used for qualitative accents (e.g., 'superpowers', stars, or premium insights).

visual_enhancers.depth_and_life: To prevent cards from feeling flat, use layered elements. Add noise textures, subtle inner glows (`box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(204,255,0,0.05)`), and overlapping absolute-positioned badges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use high-quality glassmorphism for blurred answers/names. Formula: `bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20` (dark mode) or `bg-[#12402A]/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#12402A]/10` (light mode).
visual_enhancers.image_overlays: When using background images, NEVER use flat black overlays. Use gradients: `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#12402A]/90 via-[#12402A]/40 to-transparent`. This preserves the life of the photo while ensuring text readability.

grids_layouts.carousel_container: flex gap-6 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory px-4 md:px-8 pb-12 pt-4 scrollbar-hide
grids_layouts.card_base: w-[330px] md:w-[380px] min-h-[440px] flex-shrink-0 snap-center rounded-3xl overflow-hidden relative flex flex-col justify-between group

motion.hover: Apply `group-hover:scale-105` to background images. Add slight Y-axis lift on inner cards/elements during hover.
motion.active_pulse: Use `animate-pulse` on locked icons, live dots, or progress bars to make the data feel 'live' and 'current'.
motion.progress_bars: Animate width from 0 to actual value using CSS keyframes or transition delays on mount.

cards_structure.title: Dossier Overview
cards_structure.content: Blurred name pill ('J**** S****'). Huge '8.2' overall rating in Volt Lime. Quote in gold: 'Exceptional scanning before receiving.' Identity-locked trust box at the bottom using glassmorphism.

cards_structure.title: The Four Pillars
cards_structure.content: 4 horizontal progress bars (Technical, Game Intelligence, Physical, Mentality). Use Volt Lime for the fill on a dark green track. Add a glowing dot at the end of each bar.

cards_structure.title: Superpowers & Focus
cards_structure.content: Split layout. Top: 'SUPERPOWERS' with Volt Lime check icons. Bottom: 'PRIORITY TO TRAIN' on a slightly darker floating card with a target icon. Adds depth.

cards_structure.title: Physical Reality
cards_structure.content: Large glowing stats: '24.1 KM/H MAX', '7 SPRINTS'. Includes an SVG dashed path line indicating movement across the card. Feels visceral.

cards_structure.title: Parent Curiosity
cards_structure.content: Questions like 'Is he making the right decisions?' fading into blur. A pulsing lock icon in the center with text 'Unlock the full picture'. Sells the experience.

cards_structure.title: Honest Answers
cards_structure.content: Accordion style rows. Text in Ink. One row expanded: 'How to support without pressure?' -> 'A real scout's advice on sideline behavior.'

cards_structure.title: 90-Day Plan
cards_structure.content: A vertical roadmap/timeline. 3 nodes connected by a Volt Lime dashed line. 'Today', 'Week 4', 'Week 12'.

cards_structure.title: The Road Ahead
cards_structure.content: Typography heavy. 'THE ROAD AHEAD'. A glowing Gold path graphic. Text: 'From the local pitch to the scout's notebook.' Sells the dream.

cards_structure.title: Scout Reply
cards_structure.content: Chat bubble layout. Human avatar. 'Hi there! I watched your 3 matches. Your scan rate is incredible...' Include a 'Play Voice Note' visual pill.

cards_structure.title: Scout Library
cards_structure.content: 'YOU'VE BEEN SPOTTED'. A glowing map graphic or radar UI. 'A scout from Denmark viewed your profile today.' Pulsing Volt Lime dot.

cards_structure.title: CTA
cards_structure.content: Big bold text: 'IT STARTS WITH ONE VIDEO'. Volt Lime button: 'Upload Your Video'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use drop-shadow on text if the image overlay is light.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and cards MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='sample-card-dossier'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT CREATE GENERIC CARDS. Implement the specific 11 cards outlined in `cards_structure`.
Use standard React + Tailwind. No extra heavy libraries inside the cards. Use CSS keyframes for animations (pulse, slide).
Ensure the carousel container has `snap-x snap-mandatory` and `overflow-x-auto`, while hiding the scrollbar using CSS.
Strictly follow the color palette. No fully black backgrounds.
Use Lucide React icons for UI elements (locks, checks, targets, maps).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects. Avoid universal transitions (`transition: all`). Never use AI emojis for icons. Use generous spacing.
